set.no-items: No library reports this work, so there is nothing to link.
set.kind-missing: Choose a TMDb film (Movie) or show (Series).
set.kind-invalid: “{{value}}” is not a TMDb kind. Use Movie or Series.
set.id-missing: Give the TMDb id to link.
set.season-invalid: “{{value}}” is not a season number. Use 0 to {{max, number}}.
set.episode-invalid: “{{value}}” is not an episode number. Use 1 to {{max, number}}.
set.episode-without-season: An episode number needs a season number.
set.numbers-not-allowed: Season and episode numbers go only with a show linked to a film or to an episode.
set.film-for-show: A show or an episode can be linked only to a TMDb show.
set.series-episode: Link its series instead: an episode is known by its series' ids.
set.unknown-item: “{{value}}” is not an item of this work.

list.filter-missing: Choose which links to list: Unattached, Pending, Conflict, NotWritten or Lost.
list.filter-invalid: “{{value}}” is not a link filter. Use Unattached, Pending, Conflict, NotWritten or Lost.

write.under-way: A write to the library is under way for this work; try again in a moment.
write.nothing-linked: There is nothing to write: no item of this work is linked.
write.nothing-unattached: There is nothing to write: the library no longer reports this item.
write.nothing-to-write: There is nothing to write: {{reason, message}}
write.app-error: The identification stopped because of an error in the app. Its log says more.
write.switched-off: “{{integration}}” is switched off. Switch it on under Integrations, then retry.
write.series-still-working: Jellyfin may still be working on this series after the last attempt; try again after {{time}} UTC.
write.batch-stopped: The app stopped this batch after Jellyfin failed to confirm two identifications in a row, and sent nothing for this item. Check Jellyfin, then Retry, or press Update Jellyfin again.
write.restarted: The app restarted while identifying the item in Jellyfin. Jellyfin may still be working on it: Retry in a few minutes checks what it holds before anything is sent.

kept.no-identifier: “{{integration}}” can't identify items, so a link stays in the app.
kept.no-numbers: Without a season and an episode the app has no id of this episode to identify it by.
kept.no-episode-imdb: TMDb knows no IMDb id of this episode, so its link stays in the app.

batch.work-gone: The work is no longer in the library.
batch.has-id: Its library reports a TMDb id for it now.
batch.no-longer-confident: It is no longer the work's confident suggestion.

review.index-invalid: “{{value}}” is not a place in the queue. Use 0 or more.
review.nothing-accepted: Tick at least one work to link.
review.too-many_one: At most {{count, number}} work can be linked at once.
review.too-many_other: At most {{count, number}} works can be linked at once.
review.accept-item-missing: Each ticked work needs its work, its kind and its TMDb id.

find.title-missing: Type a title to search for.
find.paste-invalid: Paste a TMDb or IMDb link, an IMDb id like tt0056164, or a TMDb number.
find.bare-number-kind: Choose film or show for a bare number.
find.imdb-not-found: TMDb has no film or show with that IMDb id. If it is an episode's, paste the show's link instead.

suggestions.queue-full: Too many TMDb suggestion runs are waiting. Try again in a minute.
suggestions.app-error: The TMDb suggestions stopped being prepared because of an error in the app. Its log says more.
suggestions.restarted: The app restarted before these TMDb suggestions were prepared. The works searched so far are kept.
suggestions.catalog-removed: The metadata catalog was removed while the TMDb suggestions were prepared. The works searched so far are kept.
